dependency.name: cranelift-codegen
dependency.contract: Nontrapping memory permits removal of unused loads and dead stores at their current program points. It does not imply arbitrary movement, readonly memory or alignment.

facts.fact: Checked allocation byte counts and limits precede a typed host-arena projection retained together with its memory domain.
The projection exactly covers its arena; every lane is initialized with T::default before exposure. u64 is a sealed supported lane type.

Checked private metadata counts extend the local bank. The owned projection is split into bounded slices; frame pointers/capacities reference those slices and stay borrowed across the synchronous entry call.
Ready, capture and temporary homes are derived with checked additions and disjoint offsets into the reserved borrowed bank.
Origin flags apply only for CodePlan::is_program; other image kinds use default memory flags.
Source bounds and opaque callback memory effects must remain. No promise is proposed for general source bytes, LF allocations, map payloads or callback argument/result buffers.

remaining: Complete and record every borrowed/scalar-tail flag call-site range/lifetime proof.
Add an independent test-only compile reference that disables only nontrapping promises, retaining existing alias regions.
